info.name: Smart Asset Management - Asset Service
info.description:
Complete asset-service API (Days 4-7).

**Run the folders top to bottom.** Start with `01 Authentication` so the token variables are captured.

Prerequisites: `npm run seed` in `asset-service` for the three demo accounts, and the service running on port 3001.

Roles:
- `admin` - full read and write
- `staff` - read only
- `technician` - read only

Every error response uses the same envelope:
```json
{ "error": { "code": "...", "message": "...", "details": [], "requestId": "..." } }
```
The `requestId` is also returned in the `x-request-id` header and accepts an inbound `x-request-id` for tracing.
